sections.text_helper: Section 32.5.12 "TIM counter (TIM_CNT)" in chapter 32 (General-purpose timers(TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1245.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bit 31 UIFCPY_CNT[31]: Value depends on IUFREMAP in TIM_CR1.
If UIFREMAP = 0
CNT[31]: Most significant bit of counter value
If UIFREMAP = 1
UIFCPY: UIF Copy
This bit is a read-only copy of the UIF bit of the TIM_ISR register
Bits 30:0 CNT[30:0]: Least significant part of counter value
Non-dithering mode (DITHEN = 0)
The register holds the counter value.
Dithering mode (DITHEN = 1)
The register holds the non-dithered part in CNT[30:0]. The fractional part is not available.
